## Open inventory work

- Enumerate the complete known official guide/reference graph; preserve unknown, unavailable, duplicate, deferred and external-service sections.
- Import pinned Discovery documents and protobuf descriptors, including every method, request/response, field, oneof, enum and transport; current surfaces are a representative seed.
- Store and verify retrieved source bodies, semantic hashes, extraction revisions, stable section locators, reviewer identity and review date before enabling reviewed states.
- Decompose broad existing invariants into source-derived atomic behavior requirements without losing existing formal, mutation, property or regression coverage.
- Bind exact production, official-emulator, replay and SDK cases to artifact/configuration/corpus/comparator identities; historical corpus reports remain separate.
- Expand Auth and Firestore vertical cases, Enterprise/Native, MongoDB, administration and SDK/platform inventories without copying evidence across scopes.
- Add upstream change monitoring, receipt staleness checks and release-artifact snapshots before making release-specific compatibility claims.

## Updating

Edit `spec/compatibility/inventory.json`, `sources/index.json`, `surfaces/index.json` and `features.json`. Link existing requirement and capability IDs; do not copy their statuses. Run:

```sh
cargo run -p compat-check -- --write-inventory
cargo run -p compat-check
cargo nextest run -p compat-check --profile pr
```

The normal CI compatibility gate rejects malformed references and missing or edited generated pages. Schema 1 intentionally rejects execution receipts and completed source-review claims until their provenance can be checked. Release snapshots and upstream monitoring are not implemented yet.
